name: Earthquake
primary:
The ground rears up: rock crumbles and everyone inside is pinned down.
A zone at the aim point with a 9-block radius for 11 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 9 ❤ earth (earth ×2 on frozen)
• Blocks within 3 blocks turn brittle for 8 s
• Breaks up to 24 blocks within 2.5 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Heaves the ground: up to 60 blocks within 9 blocks fly up, hurt on the way and crash back down, burying whatever stands below
• Rooted in place for 8 s
• Brittle (earth damage ×2) for 16 s
• Launches upward
self_description:
A zone around you with a 9-block radius for 11 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you:
• Stone skin (Resistance III) for 15 s
• Rooted in place for 2 s
